about.title: About Speed Converter
about.description: The Speed Converter is a versatile tool for converting between different units of speed and velocity including kilometers per hour, miles per hour, meters per second, knots, and specialized speed measurements. This professional speed conversion tool handles all common speed measurements used in transportation, sports, aviation, maritime navigation, and scientific research. Speed conversion is essential in automotive engineering, flight planning, marine navigation, and physics calculations. Whether you're comparing vehicle speeds, calculating travel times, converting wind speeds, or working with scientific velocity data, our converter ensures precise speed conversions with support for both everyday and specialized units across metric and imperial systems.

faq.q: What speed units does the speed converter support?
faq.a: Our speed converter supports comprehensive metric units (km/h, m/s, meters per minute), imperial units (mph, feet per second, feet per minute), and specialized units like knots for maritime navigation and Mach numbers for aviation applications.

faq.q: What is a knot and how does it relate to other speed units?
faq.a: A knot is one nautical mile per hour, equal to exactly 1.852 km/h or 1.151 mph. Knots are the standard speed unit used in maritime and aviation navigation worldwide, providing consistent measurements for wind speeds and vessel velocities.

faq.q: How do I convert between km/h and mph quickly?
faq.a: To convert km/h to mph, multiply by 0.621371. To convert mph to km/h, multiply by 1.609344. For example, 100 km/h = 62.14 mph, and 60 mph = 96.56 km/h. Our speed converter performs these calculations automatically with full precision.

faq.q: What is Mach speed and how is it calculated?
faq.a: Mach speed is the ratio of an object's speed to the speed of sound in the surrounding medium. Mach 1 equals approximately 343 m/s (1,235 km/h or 767 mph) at sea level and 20°C. Mach numbers are crucial in aerospace engineering and supersonic flight calculations.

faq.q: How accurate are the speed conversions for professional use?
faq.a: Our speed converter uses exact international conversion factors and maintains high decimal precision, making it suitable for automotive engineering, aviation calculations, maritime navigation, and scientific research applications.

faq.q: Can I convert wind speeds and weather-related velocities?
faq.a: Yes, our speed converter is perfect for converting wind speeds between different units. Weather services use various units like km/h, mph, m/s, and knots, and our converter handles all these measurements accurately for meteorological applications.
